author: Wzyss
install_msg: Thank you for installing ServerTemplate! Open the panel with `[p]servertemplate panel`. Only members with the Administrator permission can use it, and the bot needs Administrator to apply templates.
name: ServerTemplate
short: Back up a server's roles, channels, permissions, and settings and replicate them to other servers.
description: Capture a server's roles, categories, channels, permission overwrites, server settings, name/icon, and emojis into templates that are stored across every server the bot is in. Apply a template to any server through an interactive button panel, in Merge mode (update and create) or Replace mode (mirror exactly, deleting extras), with a preview of every change first. Restricted to members with the Administrator permission.
